cardEffects:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 2 level 6 or higher cards among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] By deleting 1 of your Digimon, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Dark Masters] trait from your hand to an empty space in your breeding area without paying the cost.
inheritedEffect: ＜Retaliation＞ (When only this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
name: LadyDevimon

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  In such cases, you add as many cards to your hand as possible.
rulings.question: Can I use this card's [On Play] effect to add a card to my hand when only 1 level 6 or higher card is among the revealed cards?

rulings.answer: No, the effect doesn’t activate for Digimon in breeding areas.
rulings.question: Do [On Play] effects activate for Digimon played into the breeding area by this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?

rulings.answer: No, Digimon in breeding areas aren't referenced by effects, so they don't trigger.
rulings.question: Do "when a Digimon is played" effects trigger for Digimon played into the breeding area by this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?

rulings.answer: No. It can't attack because the "Digimon can't attack the turn they came into play" rule still applies to Digimon played into the breeding area.
rulings.question: I used this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to play a Digimon into the breeding area, and another effect moved the memory to 0 or more, and my turn continued.  If the Digimon that was played into the breeding area is then moved to the battle area by an effect, can that Digimon attack?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  A "can't be played by effects" effect affects a player when it activates, therefore the act of playing a Digimon itself won't be possible, whether in the breeding area or the battle area.
rulings.question: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to play a Digimon into the breeding area when it's affected by a "Digimon can't be played by effects" effect?
